name: Secrets of the Dreamers

angles.text: As a mage, you can seek obscure tomes and magical texts to enrich scholarly archives.
As a druid, writings tied to nature magic and the Emerald Dream hold deep meaning in the Cenarion arts.
Alliance scholars, especially those who keep great repositories, depend on champions to recover lost knowledge from dangerous places.

aliases: what is secrets of the dreamers
what do you do in this quest
faq.answer: Travelers recover magical writings and obscure knowledge, then bring them to a library's scholars to enrich the archives.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the quest Secrets of the Dreamers?

aliases: who wants secrets of the dreamers
where to turn in secrets of the dreamers
faq.answer: A scholar overseeing a library's collection gathers the texts, asking travelers to bring in magical works.
The writings go into an institutional library's growing archives, where Alliance scholars and researchers can catalog and preserve rare lore and magical discoveries.
faq.q: Where are the recovered works stored?

faq.answer: The Dreamers refers to druids attuned to the Emerald Dream or ancient sleeping entities bound to nature's slumber. Writings bearing their secrets preserve mysterious primal power.
faq.q: What does the title refer to by "the Dreamers"?

aliases: can i turn in more books
faq.answer: The archivists welcome further contributions. When you find magical writings that may aid the collection, you can bring them in for continued research.
faq.q: Can you bring more magical works after finishing the quest?

aliases: why does the library need magic tomes
faq.answer: Scholars seek to widen their understanding of arcane, natural, and obscure lore. Lost or scattered treatises may hold insights into the world's deeper history and mysteries.
faq.q: Why is collecting these magical writings important to scholars?

sections.body: Scholars across the realm depend on travelers to recover rare magical texts and historical treatises. These works lie in ancient ruins or private hoards, far from the archives. So adventurers carry them safely to those who study Azeroth's arcane mysteries and preserve its lore.
sections.title: Recovering Forgotten Lore

sections.body: When travelers bring in treatises, archivists add them to the library's permanent collection. Researchers seek obscure writings on the Emerald Dream and arcane theory. Their work continues, and they welcome further magical texts found in the field.
sections.title: Expanding the Archives

summary: A library's scholars seek writings tied to the Dreamers and other magical lore. Travelers bring forgotten works from across the realm, where they can be studied and kept in the archives.
attribution: In-game quest text: Secrets of the Dreamers
